raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路早段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, gave ground inside 250M, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。二百五十米處墮退。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Showed good speed to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 展現甚快前速，領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) In rear after sluggish start, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Moderately away from gate 8, raced prominently on the outside, 1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第八檔出閘普通，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, travelled well to turn, challenged the leader after turning in, hit the front 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前走勢良佳。入直路後挑戰領放馬。一百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide in midfield, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced better than midfield but trapped 3 wide, travelled keenly, moved closer after passing 700M, no cover throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，但走第三疊，搶口。跑過七百米處後追近。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Commenced well, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened inside final furlong.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時並排領先。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後二百米轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Bumped start, raced prominently early, positioned 1 out 1 back in the middle stages, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，早段居前列。中段居第二疊第二位。直路初在催策下反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
(Jockey dropped whip near 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。
（騎師於接近二百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （騎師於接近二百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, set strong pace, headed top of home straight, bumped and lost balance 250m out, well beaten.
(Lost right hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，以快步速領放。直路初被超越。二百五十米處被碰撞，失去平衡。所負甚遠。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sluggish start, settled in rear of mid-field, forced to steady on heels 550m out, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置。五百五十米處被迫收慢避開他駒的後蹄。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced slightly better than midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍前位置。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, bumped 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。一百米處被碰撞，其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Settled midfield, no clear run at the early Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初未能望空。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Ridden to soon recover from moderate start to 5th within 3L of pace, drifted over 4L back when tempo increased at about 800M, slightly further back in 6th 500M out, fought on steadily in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策，瞬即恢復走勢，居第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。約八百米處步速加快時墮退，落後逾四個馬位。五百米處略為墮居第六位。直路上持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Towards rear on rail, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, just over 4L back into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。入直路時落後稍逾四個馬位。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Crowded soon after start, recovered to take up mid-field position, headway 200m out, flattened out final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步後瞬即受擠迫，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。二百米處上前。最後五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered to 10th on rail and then 9th 800M out, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居第十位，走內欄。八百米處居第九位。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下以穩勢上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W4W) Taken back from gate 10, raced at rear, still well back on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W4W) 自第十檔出閘，留居後列。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Wide in mid-field, didn't look keen under pressure 400m out, dropped away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處在催策下反應平平。其後墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Tracked pace, ridden 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W3W) Away well and settled 5L off the leader, kept on well early in straight, run peaked 150m out and one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W3W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬五個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W) Crowded at start, niggled at in midfield on rail, lost position when crossed drifting towards rear over 950M out, saved ground on the inside turning in for home but soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，受催策，居中間位置，走內欄。被超越時失位，九百五十米處墮居後列。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程，但瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) In touch with leaders, stayed on for pressure until running out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。在催策下保持走勢，直至末段無路可上。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘後受催策，沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward to reach 2nd making first turn, chased the leaders into home straight holding every chance until finding no extra inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 首次轉彎時在催策下上前，居第二位。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。一度甚具爭勝機會，直至五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W3W3W) Tracked pace, raced wide to final bend, improved to hold every chance 150m out, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎前走外疊。一百五十米處上前，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked on run 350M, weakened early in straight, eased inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百五十米處未能再增速。直路初轉弱。最後二百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, weakened inside 250M, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下取得領先。最後二百五十米轉弱。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W2W) Chased leader, challenged turning into home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬。轉入直路時展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W) Sat midfield 3 wide, checked after the 900M. stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。過了九百米處後勒避。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Raced 2 wide in 2nd position early. Not much progress in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 早段走二疊第二位。直路上進展不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, had every chance in the Straight, unable to go pass the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，但未能超越頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced wide without cover, chased along early, driven along 450m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段追趕領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持佳勢，但最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually close home, just stayed on to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱，僅能保持走勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began smartly from gate 11, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to lead, quickened early in home straight and kicked two lengths away 100m out, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，取得領先。直路早段加速，一百米處帶離兩個馬位。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide better than midfield, difficult to settle in the early and middle stages, 2-1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段及中段難以穩定走勢。入直路時落後二又四分一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, raced keenly throughout, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。沿途搶口。直路上迅速墮退，遙遙落後時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Began fast and dictated things in front, run peaked 150m out and knocked up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭。一百五十米處未能再增速。迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Jumped awkwardly settling in rear of midfield in 8th or 7th fought on steadily in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後的第七或第八位。直路上持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, no clear run top of the Straight, ran on okay once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空，望空後走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly to the line (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。保持穩勢至終點（見競賽事件報告）。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Broke well sharing early pace on the rail, shifted one back to 4th coming onto home bend, switched off rail for a run for short-lived effort about 350M out, soon faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段在內欄並排領放。開始轉直路彎時留後一個馬位至第四位。約三百五十米處移離內欄取位，一度發力上前，瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed approaching 100M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。三百米處取得領先。趨近一百米處時未能再增速及被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched for clear run top of home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初轉換跑線以望空。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, taken wider on bend, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎移出較外疊。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Wide with leaders from a poor draw, shifted over 1L back to 4th rounding home bend, kept on without quickening after straightening and faded under pressure inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，與領先馬匹並排，走外疊。轉直路彎時墮後逾一個馬位，居第四位。入直路後保持走勢，未能加速。最後一百米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Raced in rear of mid-field, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Out the back door early and quickly shifted across behind the field, took a while to wind up, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，早段迅速在馬群之後切入。加速需時。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven along 550m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Hampered shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 起步後不久受阻礙，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, weakened 500M, eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。五百米處轉弱，其後收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W1W1W1W1W) Jumped okay and led, traveled okay, weakened at the top of the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘尚可，領放，走勢不俗。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W2W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to chase leader from top of home straight, stuck to task but unable to bridge gap.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 跟隨領先兩駒。自直路初起在催策下追趕領放馬。持續力拼，但未能收窄距離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat behind the lead, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居領放馬之後。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W1W1W) Led, traveled smoothly, slightly weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W1W1W) 領放，走勢暢順。直路上稍為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Missed the start, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 漏閘，居後列，走外疊。中段略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually close home, finished 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Showed speed to lead, pressed in front, headed by winner 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 展現前速以領放，受追迫。三百米處被頭馬超越，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, hard ridden early in straight, checked near 200M, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初受力策。接近二百米處時勒避。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader out wide, short-lived challenge top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走外疊。直路早段一度發力展開挑戰。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Raced 2 wide in 4th position early. Shifted in at 800M. Not much progress in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 早段走二疊第四位。八百米向內移入。直路上進展不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, closed off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Held up in rear, pushed along over 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 留居後列。四百米處受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W) Settled handy, traveled wide, weakened passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。跑過二百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled fairly, disappointed for clear running, not fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置。走勢普通。未能望空，因而未能全力施為。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped at start, tracked leaders, pushed along 500m out, checked 350m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策。三百五十米處勒避，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, made late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) Led or disputed lead early stages, gradually settled about 3L off the pace 2-wide in 2nd in back straight, became 2L 3rd around home bend, folded up quickly upon straightening.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 早段領先或爭奪領先。對面直路上逐漸居第二位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走第二疊。轉直路彎時居第三位，落後兩個馬位。入直路時迅速力竭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, disputed led on bend, headed by winner 550m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路彎爭奪領先。五百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure to hold position from 800m out, dropped away quickly in home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。自八百米處起受催策以保持位置。直路上迅速墮退，洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, ran on ordinarily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。走勢普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Raced in touch, clear run up inside rail from top of home straight, good headway to lead under 100m out, comfortably on top closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。自直路初起沿內欄望空。以佳勢追前，一百米處取得領先。末段輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden along halfway to hold position, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。半程時受催策以保持位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Rear of mid-field, a bit outpaced 350m out, warmed to task and staying on when running out of room behind leaders final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。三百五十米處被略為拋離。加速上前，最後五十米在領先馬匹之後空位不足時保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Quickly into stride, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide, ridden top of home straight, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路初受催策。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W5W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, raced very wide without cover throughout, widest into home straight, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W5W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走最外疊。二百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Dropped back to last on jumping from wide draw, saved ground on the inside but still had plenty to do 400M, failed to run on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。走內疊節省腳程，但四百米處仍落後甚遠。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Settled behind midfield 3 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield, 3 wide, 5 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Led on the rail, traveled smoothly, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 沿欄領放。走勢暢順。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, headed near 600M, shared lead turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，受催策上前領放。接近六百米處時被超越。入直路時與對手並排領先。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W2W) Tracked leader, ridden to challenge over 200m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處受催策展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Won early battle for lead, pressed on 300m out, headed 100m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 早段取得領先。三百米處受催策。一百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began smartly, raced prominently, took the lead approaching 1000M, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列。趨近一千米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一馬位。直路早段保持佳勢，一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, well placed into home straight, challenged and every chance from 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居好位。自三百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長，但末段未能增速以繼續挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on outer, 6 lengths or so back, very wide into straight, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，落後約六個馬位，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, weakened quickly final 300m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受催策。最後三百米迅速轉弱，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, driven along to chase leader 450m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。四百五十米處受催策以追趕領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced in 2nd, a length back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Away in line, settled down midfield 4-5Ls off leader, failed to respond under pressure 500M, gave ground soon after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。五百米處對催策毫無反應。入直路後瞬即墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped and lost balance out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, ridden 300m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策，最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide towards rear, hampered near 700M, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列，走第二疊。接近七百米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) 3-wide in midfield early stages, taken back towards rear in 8th into back straight, hung in and unbalanced causing interferences 500M out, kept on same pace from 7th into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。入對面直路時留居後列第八位。五百米處內閃及失去平衡，造成干擾。入直路時居第七位，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Average to begin, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W) Sent forward from wide draw, across to lead outright after 500m, headed over 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前。跑了五百米後切入單騎領放。二百米處被超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Pressed leader three wide, starting to weaken when badly hampered 250m out, soon no chance.
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 追迫領放馬，走第三疊。二百五十米處受嚴重阻礙時開始轉弱。瞬即失去爭勝機會。
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier, took up running 3-wide onto first turn obtaining rails run 750M out, maintained fast tempo in front until the 400M and led until weakened 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前。開始轉首個彎位時取得領先，走第三疊。七百五十米處移入內欄。保持以快步速領放至四百米處，領先至一百五十米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on but no match to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。保持走勢，但未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Sat behind the lead on the rail, kept on fairly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路上保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Keen early, settled in mid-field, forward move wide final bend, challenged 150m out, unable to sustain effort.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W4W) 早段搶口，居中間位置。直路彎上前，走外疊。一百五十米處展開挑戰，但無以為繼。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, closed off strongly for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W) Sat handy 2 wide, raced keenly in the middle stages, kept on well under whip to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。在鞭策下保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Showed speed to take the lead after first bend, kicked 2 lengths clear 200m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 展現前速，首次轉彎後取得領先。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled midfield, raced ungenerously, responded reasonably well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢欠順。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, pushed along 400m out, unable to improve position, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。四百米處受推策。未能推進。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along final bend, switched for clear run top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎受推策。直路初轉換跑線以望空。其後在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Waited with towards rear, clear run up rail from 300m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。自三百米處起沿欄望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Raced in rear, driven along 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列。四百米處受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Outpaced early, in rear, pushed along halfway, in last pair entering home straight, stayed on well final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 早段未能跟上步速，居後列。半程時受推策。入直路時仍居最後兩名之內。最後一百五十米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on outer, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide in midfield, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, made contact near 1000M and 850M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。接近一千米處及八百五十米處時兩度被對手觸碰。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, checked near the 150M, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置。接近一百五十米處時勒避。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W4W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, angled out 500M, very wide turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Raced wide from high draw, improved to track pace before halfway, pushed along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘，走外疊。半程前推進上前以跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W4W) Rear of mid-field, taken wide and forward move turning into home straight, sustained run to lead 150m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W4W) 居中間之後位置。轉入直路時移出外疊及上前。持續上前，一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, settled in front of midfield, raced wide, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之前位置，走外疊。末段對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W5W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, commenced move 450M, very wide turning in, finished off very strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W5W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲。接近終點時領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure to challenge leader 400m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, took the early lead, headed 950M, 2nd in the middle stages, hard ridden from 200M, retook the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段取得領先。九百五十米處被超越，中段居第二位。自二百米處起受力策，一百五十米處再次取得領先。保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W1W1W) Involved in early battle for lead, led outright after 450m, responded to pressure from 300m out, challenged 100m out, winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W1W1W) 早段爭奪領先，跑了四百五十米後單騎領放。自三百米處起對催策交出反應。一百米處受挑戰。未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 6 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Jumped moderately from the wideset barrier and soon taken well back, commenced move inside the 600M racing 3-wide rounding home bend, obtained a clear run just inside the 200M, ran on well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘普通，瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。六百米處開始上前，轉直路彎時走第三疊。跑過二百米處後望空。以佳勢追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped start, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the stands' side, hard ridden from 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時與對手互相碰撞，落後領放馬兩個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。自三百米處起受力策。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Tracked leaders early stages, dropped to race in touch with leaders 700m out, checked 300m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。七百米處墮後，仍跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處勒避。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in second half of the field, 7Ls to make up 400M but failed to finish off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居後半馬群中。四百米處落後七個馬位，但末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Lacked early pace, ridden to soon recover to 7th some 6L back on rail in back straight, tightened and lost a stride 500M out, ran home one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 缺乏前速。受催策，瞬即恢復走勢。對面直路上居第七位，落後約六個馬位，走內欄。五百米處受緊迫，失去步韻。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Lacked pace early and soon dropped to rear despite ridden early, remained well behind into straight, saved ground home turn, produced good late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 早段欠缺前速，儘管受催策，但瞬即墮居後列。入直路時仍落後甚遠。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, taken wide in straight and made minor progress. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Mid-field, rail position, forced to angle wide in home straight to challenge, stayed on, got up for second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上須移出外疊以展開挑戰，保持走勢。接近終點時進佔亞席。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked leaders, keen, made effort off final bend, no extra 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，搶口。入直路時發力。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W4W) Settled in midfield 5Ls back in a slowly run event, shuffled back to a rearward position from 1000M, held up for clear running 450M to 250M before staying on well to finish 5th. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，落後五個馬位，賽事步速緩慢。自一千米處起墮居後列。四百五十米處至二百五十米處之間受困而未能望空，其後保持佳勢，跑獲第五名，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Prominent from a poor draw settling one back 2-wide in 2nd, soon weakened after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後居前列第二位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路後瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W2W2W) Jumped only fairly from a wide draw, dropped back to race at the rear, had big task in hand 400M then ran on fairly well towards the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W2W2W) 自外檔出閘僅屬一般，墮居後列。四百米處落後甚遠。末段走勢不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W2W) Broke well from a poor draw settling in last few, made rapid progress inside the 900M to share the lead 700M out, came under pressure to hold place rounding home bend and into straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居最後數位之內。九百米處迅速上前，七百米處並排領先。轉直路彎及入直路時在催策下保持位置。最後一百五十米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。未能望空直至二百五十米處。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W5W) From draw 13 unable to slot in, raced 3-wide without cover in midfield throughout, couldn't keep up with rivals passing 250M, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W5W) 自第十三檔出閘後未能切入，沿途居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過二百五十米處時未能跟上對手，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Slightly slow out and bumped, raced at tail, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘稍慢，被碰撞，居包尾位置。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in the second half of the field on the rail throughout, failed to make any impression in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後半馬群中。沿途走內欄。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat last, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段追前頗多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Raced in last place after slow start, passed a few late on, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘緩慢，其後居包尾位置。末段超越數駒。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W4W3W) Sat rear, raced rear, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W4W3W) 沿途居包尾位置。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W2W) Raced rear, made minor progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 居後列。在鞭策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Sat rear, traveled smoothly, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走勢暢順。在催策下毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, chased along to take up position in mid-field, strong run under hands and heels to lead 75m out, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，追趕對手，進佔中間位置。在騎師手足並用催策下走勢強勁，七十五米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W4W) Sat last, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W4W) 居包尾位置。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, effort 400m out, weakened final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處發力。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Settled ahead of midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running 300M but the finishing response was only fair after. (Trainer - Instructed jockey to take up a forward position on the Yielding track.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置。三百米處難以望空，但其後衝刺僅屬一般。（練馬師表示，他指示騎師在「黏地」狀況的跑道上讓此駒佔取前列位置。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Crowded start, raced at tail throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 起步時受擠迫。沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly and ended up racing in last, under pressure 500M out and soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，其後居包尾位置。五百米處受催策。瞬即再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, short of room early in home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路早段空位不足。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, some headway on bend, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎略為追前。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W2W) Raced on rail at rear early. Kept on evenly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 早段於馬群後列貼欄位置競跑。直路上維持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat against the fence midfield, briefly blocked for a run, stayed on ok, something further would suit.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。一度受困而未能望空。末段保持尚可走勢。增程角逐或更合發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W2W3W) Mid-field, forced wide and tight for room turning into home straight, again short of room 200m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時被迫走外疊，受緊迫。二百米處再度空位不足。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, held up between 300M and 200M, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處至二百米處之間受困。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W4W) Tracked pace, wide into home straight, stayed on, not beaten far but unable to reach leader.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 跟隨領放馬。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，所負不遠，但未能追及領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W3W3W2W) Moderately away, raced towards rear on the outside, sent forward 1000M, raced prominently on the outside in the middle stages, challenged the leader turning in, took the lead 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W3W3W2W) 出閘普通，居後列，走外疊。一千米處受催策上前，中段居前列，走外疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。二百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W2W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 900m out, took the lead 600m out, in control final 200m, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W2W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。九百米處開始發力，走外疊。六百米處取得領先。最後二百米控制大局。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the outside, improved on turn, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。直路彎推進。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W4W5W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W4W5W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W3W2W2W2W2W) Moderately away, raced 3 wide in midfield early, moved closer approaching 1600M, positioned 2 wide, 1/2L back in the middle stages, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened thereafter.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W3W2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，早段居中間位置，走第三疊。趨近千六米處時追近。中段落後半個馬位，走第二疊。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced at rear on the inside, 2 wide from 800M, 5 lengths or so back on turn, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。自八百米處起走第二疊。直路彎落後約五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W4W4W) Settled midfield, angled out rounding the Turn, hampered near the 300M, weakened after 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W4W4W) 居中間位置，轉直路彎時向外移出。接近三百米處時受阻礙。過了二百米處後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W2W) Held up from wide draw, pushed along 500m out, stayed on final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W2W) 自外檔出閘，留後。五百米處受推策。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W6W) Dropped in from wide draw, ridden to try and make ground wide on bend, stayed on late, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。直路彎在催策下嘗試推進，沿外疊追前。末段保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover behind midfield, never involved. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W6W) Away well but soon restrained to a rearward position, travelled well into home turn and made solid progress from 600M, ran home strongly final stages and just prevailed in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W6W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即受約束，居後列。進入直路彎時走勢良佳。自六百米處起追前甚多。末段衝刺強勁，在與亞軍馬匹幾乎齊過終點下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W3W4W4W) Jumped only fairly, sat worse than midfield, made steady progress late (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W3W4W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段穩步追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Crowded at start, ridden early to take up mid-field position, wide final bend and towards rear top of home straight, finished strongly final 150m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 起步時受擠迫，早段受催策，居中間位置。直路彎走外疊。直路初居後列。最後一百五十米衝刺強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well but just lost out to the winner in a ding-dong finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺良佳，但在叮噹馬頭下僅敗於頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped at start, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven along 800m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。八百米處受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, angled out early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路早段向外移出。三百米處望空。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W2W3W) Taken back from gate 8, raced at tail, still 9 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, made good progress in the run home to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W2W3W) 自第八檔出閘後留居包尾位置。直路彎仍落後九個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段追前甚多，獲得季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W2W) Held up last, some headway final bend, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, strong run to edge ahead close home in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路彎略為追前。未能望空直至一百五十米處。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide towards rear, similar position on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎位置相若。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled midfield, checked rounding the Turn when improved into doubtful room, ran on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時在推進至空位不足處之際勒避。走勢一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on under pressure, snatched third on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持走勢。過終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, improved between rivals to challenge 150m out, stayed on and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。在對手之間上前，一百五十米處展開挑戰。保持走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, looking to improve when short of room 300m out to 200m out, unable to quicken once clear, lost ground final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處至二百米處之間在空位不足下嘗試推進，但望空後未能加速。最後五十米失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W2W) Tracked pace, three wide, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, commenced move after passing 500M, 1-1/2L back turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly, lost two places towards finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，局中間之前位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後開始上前。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。走勢平穩。接近終點時失去兩位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W2W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear on the inside, 8 lengths back, a bit closer on turn, angled out 350M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘後留後，居後列，走內疊，落後八個馬位。直路彎略為追前。三百五十米處向外移出。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked pace, chased leaders from top of home straight, stayed on well, gradually closing down winner final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自直路初起追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，最後一百米逐漸追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Switched off to race at the rear of the field over 10Ls back middle stages, steadied 300M when commencing to finish off the race, had to change lane but the final effort was just fair.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 留居後列。中段落後逾十個馬位。三百米處在開始衝刺之際收慢。末段須轉換跑線，但衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W2W2W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early and middle stages, no clear run until 200M, could not be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，早段及中段搶口。未能望空直至二百米處，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat in front of midfield, traveled nicely, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走勢良佳。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, sat towards rear, traveled nicely, was crowded making the Turn, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走勢良佳。轉直路彎時受擠迫。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W4W) Sat at the rear 2 wide, stayed on strongly late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride near last 8-9Ls off the pace, had big task in hand top of straight, failed to respond and finished tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居接近包尾位置，留力候上，落後領放馬八至九個馬位。直路初落後甚遠。末段對催策毫無反應，大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, had to wait for run briefly entering home straight headway between horses, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。入直路時一度須等待空位出現，在馬匹之間追前。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Raced behind midfield on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, unable to quicken under pressure 300m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處在催策下未能增速。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat at the back 3 wide, never in contention.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W) 居後列，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Slow to jump, sat towards rear, no contention.
(Lost right hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。未有參與競逐。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, wide into home straight, kept going but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W3W) Sat just behind the leaders, travelled nicely at the top of the Straight, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路初走勢良佳，在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield, traveled reasonably well, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢不俗。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Stumbled leaving stalls then squeezed out, good headway up inside rail over 300m out, unable to sustain and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時失蹄，其後受擠迫。三百米處沿欄追前甚多。最後一百米後繼無力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide better than midfield early, dropped to midfield after entering the back straight, 3 wide after passing 900M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。進入對面直路後墮居中間位置。跑過九百米處後走第三疊。轉入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。未能加速。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on but no further impression late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢，但末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W4W) Away well enough, restrained to race in midfield, had 5Ls to make up on leader 400M, ran on steadily to the line for 4th without troubling the easy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W4W) 出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置。四百米處落後領放馬五個馬位。末段穩步上前，取得第四名，未能威脅輕鬆勝出的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, lacked pace to challenge.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至一百米處。速度不足以展開挑戰。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke well settling just over 1L off the pace in 3rd on rail, gained closer on the inside turning in for home, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後領放馬稍逾一個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時追近，走內疊。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, under pressure to hold position on bend, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎在催策下保持位置。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Caught racing wide without cover in midfield 4-5Ls away, stayed on well final 300M to claim 2nd just before line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間位置，落後四至五個馬位，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米保持佳勢，僅於過終點前取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Away with them, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross 800M, found rail 600M, 2 lengths back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居前列，走第二疊。八百米處讓對手過頭。六百米處移入內欄。入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Broke well from the one draw settling just off the pace on rail, remained in 3rd but further away from pacemaker in back straight, within 2L when 2nd turning in for home, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後位置，走內欄。對面直路上仍居第三位，但進一步落後領放馬。入直路時居第二位，落後不逾兩個馬位。瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, restrained to race near last, driven along 500M, held up briefly near 200M but never going the pace to challenge leaders. (Jockey - no explanation for the disappointing performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，受約束，居接近包尾位置。五百米處受催策。接近二百米處時一度受困，但速度不足以挑戰領先馬匹。（騎師未能就坐騎令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, switched and driven 400m out, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處轉換跑線及受催策。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on very well in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, keen early, ridden on bend to chase leaders out wide, short-lived effort 300m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。早段搶口。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹，走外疊。三百米處一度上前。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on nicely to the line, just won.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持佳勢至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, gave ground slightly passing the 150M, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策以領放。跑過一百五十米處時略為墮退。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a smart pace mid-race, kicked over 1L clear after straightening but unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 70M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即帶頭，中段以快步速領放。入直路後加速帶離一個馬位，但無以為繼，最後七十米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, unable to quickened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路上未能增速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Clean jump, raced prominently on the inside, travelled well to turn, took the lead early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the first few on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 出閘俐落，居前列，走內疊。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路初取得領先。保持佳勢，但過終點時未能抗衡頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact at start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader, hard ridden 400M but only showed limited response, hampered near 250M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬一個半馬位。四百米處受力策，但僅能略為交出反應。接近二百五十米處時受妨礙，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in mid-field, did not get best of runs final 300m when trying to improve, stayed on but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。最後三百米嘗試推進，但取位不太暢順。保持走勢，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Sat 3 wide no cover in front of midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, closed off nicely, just lost in a photo.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳，在電眼判決下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Wide in mid-field, keen mid-race, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。中段搶口。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Ridden along in first few, drifted over 2L back in 5th 800M out, slightly worse into straight but recovered some late ground closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 受催策，居前列。八百米處墮居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位。入直路時略為墮後，但末段收復部分失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Ridden forward gradually from a wide barrier to join the leader 800M out, came under pressure again from 500M out but folded up quickly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下逐漸上前，八百米處追上領放馬。自五百米處起再度受催策，但入直路後迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W) Broke well from a poor draw holding 2nd 2-wide, quickened to hit the front entering home straight only to overhauled 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，保持居第二位，走第二疊。其後加速，進入直路時取得領先，僅於二百米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged up rail from 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W3W) Sat last, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Sat last, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 居尾列。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Tracked pace, ridden to hold position from 400m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起在催策下保持位置。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Towards rear, stayed on inside rail, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，固守內欄。受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Crowded in rear of midfield on first bend dropping to last few, remained in similar rear position near the rail entering home straight, made modest progress behind runners.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，受擠迫。轉首個彎位時墮居最後數位之內。入直路時仍居相若的後列位置，靠近內欄競跑。在馬群之後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, raced greenly, never impress. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊，走勢稚嫩。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Sat 3 wide near the rear, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Sat handy, weakened entering the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居前列。進入直路時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover behind midfield, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, switched for clear run top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路初轉換跑線以望空。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Began well, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Ridden early before gradually settling in 6th within 3L of pace, swung wide for a run into straight, made moderate progress under pressure early on but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段受催策，繼而逐漸居第六位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。入直路時移出外疊取位。直路早段在催策下略為追前，但最後一百米後繼無力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, angled out rounding the home turn, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時向外移出。走勢不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Close up early before dropping to midfield when given some nudging 950M out, one-paced when hampered 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。其後於九百五十米處受催策，墮居中間位置。二百米處受阻礙，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched back to rail and headway 200m out, stayed on, clear of remainder.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。二百米處移回內欄，上前。保持走勢。拋離其他馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Wide in mid-field, ridden along to hold position throughout, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。沿途受催策以保持位置。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Began well from gate 10, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, carried wider turning in, kept on same pace in straight, not enough room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時被帶出更外疊。直路上保持同速。接近終點時空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled okay, briefly held up at the top of the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走勢不俗。直路初一度受困。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced better than midfield but trapped wide, moved closer after passing 1100M, 2nd on turn, 2 wide, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過千一米處後追近。直路彎居第二位，走第二疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, driven along 500m out, lost touch final 200m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。最後二百米被拋離。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, there to turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, made no impression.
(Roarer.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。毫無表現。
（患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Soon dropped to last few racing wide throughout despite ridden along, last rounding home bend, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 瞬即墮居最後數位之內。儘管受催策，但沿途走外疊。轉直路彎時居包尾位置。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Mid-field, forward move and in touch with leaders turning into home straight, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時發力上前，跟隨領先馬匹。瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Sent forward to be outside the lead, weakened and faded in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 受催策上前，居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱及力竭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 800m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處一度受阻礙。直路初受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Led early, headed after 500m, remained prominent, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 早段領放。跑了五百米後被超越。保持居前列。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced 3-wide in midfield, struggled to keep up 600M, soon beaten turning home. (Jockey - may not have appreciated racing on AWT / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處難以跟上對手。轉直路彎時瞬即洩氣。（騎師表示，坐騎或未能適應在全天候跑道上作賽。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W5W) Shifted in and lost balance at start, tracked pace out wide without cover, hampered 400m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W5W) 起步時向內斜跑及失去平衡，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受阻礙。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began only fairly, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居領放馬之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced 2 wide, 1 to 2 lengths back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，落後一至兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, stayed on final 200m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, some headway under pressure 200m out, flattening out when hampered 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。二百米處在催策下略為追前。五十米處受阻礙之際洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Settled in worse than midfield, in similar position into home straight, briefly baulked over 200M out, ran home one-paced without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時居相若位置。二百米處一度受困。末段保持同速，未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked pace, no extra and lost ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。最後一百五十米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact at start, raced towards rear on the stands' side, hard ridden from 400M but showed no response, eased final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時發生觸碰，居後列，靠近外欄競跑。自四百米處起受力策，但毫無反應。最後一百五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside the lead, gave ground from the 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。自三百米處起墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Out fast, stranded 3 wide no cover throughout, stuck on gamely despite a tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘迅速，沿途走第三疊，沒有遮擋。儘管多走腳程，但保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled okay on the rail, made good progress inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄，走勢尚可。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 400M, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Settled towards the rear, made ground near the rail. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列。靠近內欄追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at tail, 8-1/2L back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後八個半馬位。直路上毫無進展。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) Sat on pace on the rail, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 居前列，走內欄。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Raced in rear, pushed along 500m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。五百米處受推策。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W2W2W) Crowded shortly after start, positioned 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W2W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Crowded on jumping, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 躍出時受擠迫，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, same position on turn, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎居相同位置。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Rear of mid-field, headway 300m out, unable to sustain and no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。三百米處追前。末段無以為繼，未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced better than midfield on the outside, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled handy, traveled nicely, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走勢良佳。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Began well from a poor draw but gradually taken back remaining wide throughout, reached second last into straight, renewed effort inside final 200M producing good late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但逐漸留後。沿途走外疊。入直路時居尾二位置。最後二百米重新發力。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide no cover, ran on strongly, just got caught on the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。走勢強勁，僅於終點線上被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Sat behind mid, traveled strongly, lay in inside 200M, showed dash over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢強勁。二百米處內閃。末段加速上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace, pushed along 400m out, stayed on, tight for room and unable to be ridden out fully final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策，保持走勢。最後一百米受緊迫，未能被全力催策。
