runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled at the rear 3 wide, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Moderate start, gradually recovered along rail to be up with the pace after the first 200M, shifted 2L back to 4th 600M out on top of home bend, renewed effort inside final 200M but never threatened the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，其後沿欄逐漸恢復走勢，過了首二百米後跟上步速。六百米處直路彎早段居第四位，落後兩個馬位。最後二百米重新發力，但從未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, checked 200M, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處勒避。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Taken back to the rear from wide draw, remained in last 400M 5Ls to make up, came from well back and made some inroads, but couldn't get into it.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。四百米處仍居包尾位置，落後五個馬位。自遙遙落後的位置略為追前，但未能上前爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, followed winner into home straight, ran on well to close on winner late but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時跟隨頭馬。末段以佳勢上前，追近頭馬，但始終未能超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Settled in midfield, came under pressure onto home bend, one of the widest into straight, ran on to assert authority close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。開始轉直路彎時受催策。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。追前，接近終點時控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Began moderately settling towards rear, kept on one pace without quickening from a similar position into home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列。入直路時保持同速，未能自相若位置加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Started well from wide draw but soon taken back to race in rear, stayed on well down the outside final 200m and passed several rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留居後列。最後二百米保持佳勢，走外疊，超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, good headway final bend, sustained headway to challenge 200m out, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前甚多。持續推進，二百米處展開挑戰。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Prominent 3-wide without cover in early stages, obtained cover in 2L 5th over 1000M out, slightly further off the speed rounding home bend and 6th into straight, fought on under pressure inside final 200M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 早段居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處居第五位，落後兩個馬位，有遮擋。轉直路彎時略為落後領放馬更遠。入直路時居第六位。最後二百米在催策下力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, showed good response early in straight, took the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應良佳，一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Sat box-seat, ran on nicely early in the Straight, run peak at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初以佳勢追前。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W) Sat handy on the rail, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。末段走勢強勁，取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Tracked pace, caught wide and didn't settle fully, moved upsides leader top of home straight, seen off by that rival and no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，未能完全穩定走勢。直路初上前追逼領放馬，未能超越，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 100M, kept on very well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Unable to slot in from gate 10 and covered ground throughout, raced ungenerously in the middle stages, faded under pressure inside final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十檔出閘，未能切入內疊。沿途多走腳程。中段走勢欠順。最後二百米受催策時力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Sat in front of midfield 3 wide, run peak at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Away only fairly from the middle of the line, recovered to be midfield one off, held up briefly at the home turn, travelled to the line ok (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自中檔出閘僅屬一般，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎一度受困。末段走勢尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W3W3W) Settled in rear 3-wide from the widest barrier, commenced move and wider rounding home bend, finished off the race well inside final 150M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，居後列，走第三疊。轉直路彎時開始上前，走更外疊。最後一百五十米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, caught in a pocket behind front two against rail when trying to challenge 150m out, switched 100m out, ran on well and still closing at line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一百五十米處嘗試沿欄展開挑戰時在頭兩名馬匹之後坐包廂。一百米處轉換跑線。末段以佳勢追前，過終點時仍持續追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught racing 3-wide without cover towards the tail of the field, couldn't muster the pace to challenge on straightening. (Jockey fined for failing to ride out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居尾列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時未能加速以展開挑戰。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點，表現未能令小組滿意而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced keenly in the early and middle stages and refused to settle, couldn't quicken enough in the straight, no extra final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般。早段及中段搶口，不願穩定走勢。直路上加速不足。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, quickly lost place early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞。跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路早段迅速失位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (4W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(4W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。一百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Raced outside of leader, unable to quicken with that rival 300m out, stuck to task, stayed on closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。三百米處未能與領放馬一同加速。末段在力拼下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield but trapped wide early, sent forward after passing 700M, took the lead 600M, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後受催策上前。六百米處取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the outside, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Travelled wide throughout after beginning from a wide barrier, improved steadily from towards rear to reach 2L 4th in back straight 800M out, drifted wider into straight and soon weakened out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後沿途走外疊。自後列穩步上前，八百米處在對面直路上進佔第四位，落後兩個馬位。入直路時移出較外疊。瞬即轉弱，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (4W1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, kept on nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(4W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。保持佳勢，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Disputed lead, led outright and pressed on halfway, headed only late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 爭奪領先位置。半程時單騎領放及受催策。僅於末段僅被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began from a wide barrier, took up running after first 100M and rails run 900M out onto first turn, steadied up the pace rounding home bend, led until swamped when no extra inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘。跑了一百米後進佔領先位置。九百米處首次轉彎時走內欄。轉直路彎時減慢步速。末段領放，直至最後五十米再無餘力，被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Slowly away, wide towards rear, hung left halfway, very wide turning into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走外疊。半程時外閃。入直路時走大外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat on pace, weakened inside 150M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Away with them, raced prominently, 2 wide, same position on turn, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed 150M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。三百米處取得領先。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped to last early despite ridden along, made headway on rail after first 200M to reach 8th towards rear shortly afterwards, snuck up on inside in straight reaching within 2L of pace briefly 200M out, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 儘管受催策，但於早段墮居包尾位置。過了首二百米後沿欄追前，其後不久進佔後列的第八位。直路上追前，走內疊。二百米處一度落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 600m out, short of room top of home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。直路初空位不足。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, no clear run until 200M, ran on well afterwards.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。未能望空直至二百米處，其後以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Mid-field, stayed on well for pressure final 300m, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。最後三百米在催策下保持佳勢，但未能追及頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) In rear, still plenty to do top of home straight, short of room when trying to improve 300m out, stayed on well once clear final 200m, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居後列。直路初仍落後甚遠。三百米處在嘗試推進時空位不足。最後二百米望空後保持佳勢，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W3W) Broke well before settling towards rear in 8th or 9th, ran on under pressure in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，其後居後列第八或第九位。直路上受催策上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, stayed on well along the inside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。沿內疊保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W2W2W) Mid-division, headway through field top of home straight, chased winner home from 200m out, gaining at line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初在馬群中穿插上前。自二百米處起追趕頭馬，過終點時仍在追近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W5W) Raced 3 wide in midfield early. Made progress on the outside in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W5W) 早段於馬群中間三疊位置競跑。直路上沿跑道外側上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on strongly, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段保持強勁走勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W3W) Shortly after the start was tight for galloping room and was then ridden conservatively, responded well under reminders in the home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W3W) 起步後不久受緊迫，繼而留後。直路上對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls and crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, effort 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時被碰撞，其後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, lay out throughout the middle stages, angled out 400M, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。中段沿途外閃。四百米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last, never impress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居尾列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, nothing extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W) 居前列。走勢不俗。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Involved in early battle for lead, chased leader until no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 早段爭奪領先。追趕領放馬，直至最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along final bend to chase leaders, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎受推策，追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，但未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置﹐走第二疊。未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢普通。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W4W) Out with rest, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, weakened early in straight when hard run took effect.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。早段耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in last few on rail from the widest barrier, saved ground in a similar position into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，居相若位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, headway out wide on bend, stayed on and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前，走外疊。保持走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Tracked leaders, dropped to mid-field 800m out, moved smoothly into contention 400m out, stayed on but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。八百米處墮居中間位置。四百米處順勢上前挑戰。保持走勢，但不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Heavily bumped and lost balance out of stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, short of room top of home straight, followed winner through 200m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時被大力碰撞，嚴重失去平衡。居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初空位不足。二百米處跟隨頭馬上前，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Rear of mid-field, wide into home straight, headway onto heels of leaders 200m out, run flattened out when a bit tight for room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時走外疊。二百米處上前緊隨領先馬匹，末段在略受緊迫之際洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Began well from the widest draw, trapped wide in midfield, no cover throughout, a bit closer turning in, finished off strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時略為追近。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, made some progress after passing 250M, blocked close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。跑過二百五十米處後略為追前，接近終點時受困。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Not hurried and raced in second half of the field throughout in a fast run race, urged along 450M, picked up well to challenge for the lead mid-straight but no match for winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 留力候上，沿途在快步速下居後半馬群中。四百五十米處受催策。加速良佳，直路中段爭奪領先，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back, same position on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began fairly gradually settling in 4th mainly about 3L off the pace, came to challenge inside the 350M reaching 2L 2nd briefly inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，逐漸居第四位，大多落後領放馬約三個馬位。三百五十米處上前展開挑戰。二百米處一度進佔第二位，落後兩個馬位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, briefly hampered 1600m out, shuffled back mid-race, wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。千六米處一度受阻礙。中段墮後。入直路時走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W5W) Settled well behind and waited with, commenced move approaching final turn to be one of the widest into home straight, made significant progress to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 遙居於後，留力候上。趨近直路彎時開始上前。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Raced in rear of mid-field, not best of runs 400m out to 100m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。四百米處至一百米處之間取位不太暢順。其後保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Box seat, challenged and every chance from 400m out, ran on well but always held, lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居包廂位置。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，但一直落後，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled smoothly, responded nicely under whip.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢暢順。對鞭策反應良佳。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W4W) Raced in mid-pack but stayed close enough to leaders, picked up well when urged along near 400M, led early straight before keeping on well to the line. Just couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，但保持落後領先馬匹不遠。接近四百米處時在催策下以佳勢加速。直路初領先，其後保持佳勢至終點。僅於末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Close up early restraining one-out-one-back to 4th rounding first bend, drifted back to 6th on restraint about 750M out, kept on steadily under pressure in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。轉首個彎位時受約束，居第二疊第二位，即馬群中的第四位。約七百五十米處在約束下墮居第六位。直路上在催策下保持穩勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped after the start, obtained running in midfield, driven along 500M but not going the pace to challenge, weakened 200M. (Jockey - would be better suited by stepping up in distance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處受催策，但未能加速以展開挑戰。二百米處轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎下仗若可增程角逐將更適合發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W) Settled just off midfield on the rail, made some ground along the rail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。末段沿欄略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, angled out 550M, 4-1/2L back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後四個半馬位，直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, under pressure from the 600M, weakened soon after. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。自六百米處起受催策，其後瞬即轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W3W) Settled in 5th spot ahead of midfield, driven out near 400M, ran on well to be nearest at the line. Just missed 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之前第五位。接近四百米處時受力策。走勢良佳，過終點時最為接近。僅失亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Settled down 2-wide in midfield just over 4Ls away, little change in position to the straight, stayed on well final 300M to be nearest at the line. Beaten only 0.5L into 6th in a blanket finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，落後稍逾四個馬位，走第二疊。直路前位置大致不變。最後三百米保持佳勢。過終點時最為接近，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下取得第六名，僅以半個馬位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on the outside, commenced move 400M, 4 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走外疊。四百米處開始上前，入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得亞軍，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well from gate 13, raced prominently, 2 wide, challenged the leader 550M, kept on well until approaching final 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。五百五十米處挑戰領放馬，保持佳勢至趨近最後五十米。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W1W) Jumped well from gate 10, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Did not show sufficient pace to lead the event, took a trailing spot behind leader, had to be pushed along 500M, faded final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 未能展現足夠前速領放，居領放馬之後有遮擋的位置。五百米處須受推策。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after leaving stalls, showed good speed to lead, headed 250m out, weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘後不久發生碰撞。展現甚快前速領放。二百五十米處被超越。接近終點時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W1W) Sat in behind the leaders 4th, remained close enough turning for home but lacked a finishing kick, weakened final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居領先馬匹之後的第四位。轉直路彎時仍居接近位置，但未能加速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Pressed forward from the widest draw travelling 3-wide around first bend, came to join race leader turning into back straight, disputed lead into home straight holding every chance until inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前。轉首個彎位時走第三疊。轉入對面直路時追上領放馬，進入直路時爭奪領先，保持爭勝機會至一百米處。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, a length or so back, shared lead from 600M, peaked and headed 200M, weakened and eased final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，落後約一個馬位。自六百米處起並排領先。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱，收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路初未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W3W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier before shifting back to behind midfield some 7L off the pace in back straight, renewed effort 3-wide rounding home bend and wider into straight, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。對面直路上留居中間之後位置，落後領放馬約七個馬位。轉直路彎時重新發力，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。走勢平穩，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Bumped and unbalanced shortly after start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
(Lame in right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞及失去平衡，居第二位，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。末段保持穩勢。
（右後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W2W2W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 7 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W2W2W4W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, found rail near 950M, shared lead on turn, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百五十米處時移入內欄。直路彎並排領先。直路初未能再增速，被超越。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the early lead, headed near 1250M, 2nd in the middle stages, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘普通，早段受催策上前領放。接近一千二百五十米處時被超越。中段居第二位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Taken back to race 3 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎略為追近。直路早段追前頗多。一百米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Away with them, positioned 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, there to turn, closed off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped with them, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along wide into home straight, bumped 450m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時受推策，走外疊。四百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W2W) Settled at the back from a wide draw and waited with, made up good ground under pressure in home straight though never threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。直路上在催策下追前甚多，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, did not get best of runs in home straight when trying to improve, eye-catching finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮退。直路初仍居包尾位置。直路上嘗試推進時取位不太暢順。以悅目走勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W3W4W) Dropped back to race near the rear, had 5Ls to make up 400M, made some headway without threatening leaders in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W3W4W) 墮居後列競跑，四百米處落後五個馬位，直路上略為追前，但未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W2W3W) Hampered 1300M out before settling in last few on rail, went wide for a run entering home straight, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W2W3W) 千三米處受阻礙，其後居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時移出外疊取位。末段在跑道中央受催策上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield in 6th within 5L off the pace, went wide for a run into straight but could only run home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間第六位，落後領放馬不逾五個馬位。入直路時走外疊取位，但末段僅保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled not far off on rail, drifted some 4L off the pace in 5th about 1200M out, slightly closer into home straight, fought on under pressure to reach 2.5L 2nd 100M out but without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 落後領先馬匹不遠，走內欄。約千二米處居第五位，落後領放馬約四個馬位。入直路時略為追近。在催策下力拼，一百米處進佔第二位，落後兩個半馬位，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat rear, switched out at the Turn, lay in in the Straight, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。直路上內閃。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Broke well settling towards rear, 3-wide behind midfield early in back straight before gaining closer to within 4L of pace briefly 700M out, soon drifted some 5L back to 8th onto home bend, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居後列。對面直路早段居中間之後位置，走第三疊。七百米處追近，一度落後領放馬不逾四個馬位。開始轉直路彎時瞬即墮退至第八位，落後約五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, still in rear top of home straight, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。直路初仍居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, dropped to rear turning into home straight, ran on well, just lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時墮居後列。走勢良佳，僅失去亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Shifted out at start, held up last, ridden along 600m out, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，留居包尾位置。六百米處受催策。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, improved to chase leader 1000m out, challenged leader top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處推進上前，追趕領放馬。直路初挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early stages, stayed on to grab 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。早段搶口。保持走勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W3W) Reserved in a second half of the field 5-6Ls off the pace, held up on the home turn when the race got serious, into clear running 350M and finished off well to get up in closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W3W) 留居後半馬群中，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。賽事進入關鍵階段時在直路彎受困。三百五十米處望空。衝刺良佳，末段取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Keen early, tracked pace, unable to match winner from 200m out but stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 早段搶口，跟隨領放馬。自二百米處起未能抗衡頭馬，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, travelled keenly throughout the middle stages, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。中段沿途搶口。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out after passing 500M, no daylight early in straight, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時與對手互相碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段未能望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, a bit closer in the middle stages, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。中段略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, difficult to obtain clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 250M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段難以望空。跑過二百五十米處後望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped back to the rear on jumping from a wide draw, had a ground saving trip on the inside, had some work to do 400M, closed off fastest to finish a close 5th, nearest at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置，走內疊節省腳程。四百米處仍落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，取得第五名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide, driven 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。五百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sluggish start, raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, one paced and unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Pressed leader, dropped to track leaders middle stages, driven along to chase leaders 400m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 追迫領放馬。中段墮後，跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled towards rear on rail, steadied behind runners and lost position between the 900 and 700M, renewed effort rounding home bend saving ground into straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。九百米處至七百米處之間在馬群之後收慢，失位。直路彎重新發力，入直路時走內欄節省腳程。末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure to hold position 600m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。六百米處在催策下保持位置，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position final bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎難以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, chased along final bend, ran on well final 200m to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎追趕對手。最後二百米走勢良佳，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W3W3W) Out in line, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 3 wide from 600M, a bit closer on turn, made some progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上略為追前，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W3W) Settled towards rear 3-wide without cover, gave ground on home bend.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Impeded leaving stalls, held up last, had to wait for run turning into home straight, twice short of room when trying to improve in home straight, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時受阻，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路上在嘗試推進之際兩度空位不足。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) From draw 3 dropped back to race near last, kept to inside throughout, closed off quite well to go 2nd close home without troubling the winner. (Jockey fined for returning 3 lbs overweight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，墮後至接近包尾位置。沿途走內疊。末段衝刺頗佳，接近終點時進佔第二位，但未能威脅頭馬。（騎師因返回覆磅時超磅三磅而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。未能望空直至一百米處。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed no early pace and settled to be the last few on the rail, briefly held up in the last 100M, travelled strongly to the line, did not disgrace at all.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 欠缺前速，居最後數位之內，走內欄。最後一百米一度受困。以勁勢衝刺至終點。表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, driven 400m out to chase leaders, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, some headway on bend, clear run 150m out, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路彎略為追前。一百五十米處望空，以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, hung in 150m out, ran on well to move into second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。一百五十米處內閃。走勢良佳，接近終點時進佔第二位。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped on terms, soon race in a forward spot just off the pace, driven to lead inside 250M, fought on late to hold off runner up in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，瞬即居前列，緊隨領放馬。二百五十米處在催策下領先。末段力拼，在短兵相接下力拒亞軍馬匹取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure throughout, lacked pace to challenge up rail in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。沿途受催策。直路上走內欄，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Dropped back form wide draw to race in a position near last, wide into straight but couldn't quite finish off in the straight. (Jockey : disadvantaged by settling back in the field.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居接近包尾位置。入直路時走外疊。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。（騎師表示，坐騎居後列，不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, raced keenly, raced very wide throughout, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。搶口。沿途走大外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Average to begin, urged along early stages to stay in touch with the field 4 back the fence, dashed home when winner was off and gone.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，早段受催策以跟上馬群，落後四個馬位，走內欄。末段發力衝刺，但頭馬已加速帶離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped fairly settling in midfield on rail, soon came to challenge under pressure upon straightening, gained upper hand 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內欄。入直路後瞬即在催策下展開挑戰。五十米處佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Severely checked after the start when crowded between rivals, ended up in last spot 4-5Ls back, ran on final 300M without seriously threatening leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後在對手之間受擠迫之際大力勒避，因而居包尾位置，落後四至五個馬位。最後三百米追前，未能真正威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Broke well from a middle barrier, travelled in 2nd 3-wide without cover before gaining 2-wide position onto home bend, held every chance in straight until outsprinted by the winner inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第七檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。開始轉直路彎時移入第二疊。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，最後一百五十米被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 1 sat handily behind leaders, moved up to challenge for the lead early straight, led inside 200M and had every chance, caught by first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹。直路初上前爭奪領先。二百米處取得領先，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段被首兩名馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Not far off early, improved to one-out-one-back 600M out, hit the front over 250M out only to find no extra inside final 100M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 早段落後不遠。六百米處推進至第二位，走第二疊。二百五十米處取得領先，僅於最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced very wide with the leaders holding narrow advantage between the 800 and 600M, close-up in 2nd on rail turning into straight, unable to draw level throughout and swamped for 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與領先馬匹並跑，走大外疊。八百米處至六百米處之間以短距離領先。轉入直路時沿欄追近，居第二位，但一直未能追上頭馬。最後數步被超越，失去亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Went forward, emerged as leader 850M, pressed by rival middle stages, hung on to the lead until passing 200M, weakened rapidly late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 上前，八百五十米處取得領先。中段受對手追迫。保持領先直至跑過二百米處。末段迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away swiftly, tracked speed one off the rail, loomed up 150m out and quickened nicely to score, despite laying in over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。一百五十米處追前。末段雖然內閃，但以佳勢加速上前，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken well back early from a wide barrier, ridden forward to reach 9th towards rear inside the 700M remaining 3-wide without cover to straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，早段遙居於後。受催策上前，七百米處進佔後列的第九位。直路前仍走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped in line, dropped back to sit behind mid-division, brought widest for his challenge in the straight, closed off well to go 2nd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，墮居中間之後位置。直路上移至最外疊展開挑戰。衝刺良佳，接近終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped fairly settling over 2L back in 6th on rail, drifted further off the pace rounding home bend switching off the rail for a run, ran on steadily inside final 150M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居第六位，落後逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時落後領放馬更遠，移離內欄取位。最後一百五十米穩步上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race 2 wide slightly behind midfield early, found rail near 600M, 4 lengths back on turn, closed off well to take 2nd on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段留居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時移入內欄。直路彎落後四個馬位。衝刺良佳，過終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Settled 3-wide without cover behind midfield, one of the widest when further away turning in for home, ran on well in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉入直路時落後更遠，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。直路上以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Taken across to the outside rail, sat behind midfield, navigated through traffic final two furlongs, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;留居中間之後位置，移出外欄。最後四百米在馬匹之間穿插上前。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Prominent and wide without cover while ridden along, quickened well to take charge inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 在催策下居前列，走外疊，沒有遮擋。加速良佳，最後一百五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Pressed forward from a low draw to within 2L of pace onto course proper, swamped under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自內檔出閘後受催策上前。跑離分支直路時落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。最後二百米受催策，但仍被馬群超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Settled in worse than midfield in 8th, checked and switched for a run 300M out but did not find much until too late 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後第八位。三百米處勒避，轉換跑線以望空，但空位不足直至一百米處。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Away in line, raced in midfield, was steadied 600M when crowded for room, did not run on when asked for an effort in the home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫之際收慢。直路上受催策時未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat handy, traveled smoothly, kept on under whip, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居前列位置，走勢順暢。在催策下保持走勢，末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Tracked leading pair, effort 300m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領放兩駒。三百米處受催策，最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, very wide into straight, made minor progress in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in rear and waited with, ran on well down the centre of home straight to snatch 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路上在跑道中央以佳勢上前。末段跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled towards rear on rail from moderate start, made gradual headway from the 600M to reach 3L 7th into straight, quickened well inside final 150M to just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步普通，居後列，走內欄。自六百米處起逐漸上前，入直路時進佔第七位，落後三個馬位。最後一百五十米加速良佳，過終點時僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Began well from a poor draw gradually settling over 4-wide towards rear of bunched field, commenced move 650M out swinging the widest into straight, ran on under pressure to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，逐漸居馬群後列，走第四疊。六百五十米處開始上前。入直路時移出最外疊。末段在催策下上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 3 wide better than midfield early, 2 wide from 600M, finished off strongly to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間之前位置，走第三疊。自六百米處起走第二疊。衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 150M, finished off strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。一百五十米處望空。末段衝刺強勁。接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Mid-field, tight for room when challenging up rail over 200m out, clear 150m out and stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。二百米處在沿欄展開挑戰之際受緊迫。一百五十米處望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, strong run from 200m out to lead close home despite edging right and making contact with runner-up near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自二百米處起以勁勢追前，雖然於接近終點時向內斜跑及與亞軍馬匹互相觸碰，但仍能取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Chased leaders on rails, weakened out of contention under pressure inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿欄追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米在催策下轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, tracked leaders against rail, challenged up rail from 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞。跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, momentarily racing wide without cover before ridden along to be outside the leader, battled on well but just couldn't hold off the winner over final 50m (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，一度走外疊，沒有遮擋。其後受催策上前，居領放馬外側。以佳勢力拼，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Well there from a low draw, snatched up when crossed on rail 600M out, angled out from 2L 3rd 450M out for a clear run into straight but could only keep on at the one pace without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自內檔出閘，居好位。六百米處在內欄被過頭之際勒避。四百五十米處居第三位，落後兩個馬位，向外移出以於入直路時望空，但其後僅能保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) From wide draw ended up chasing leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, couldn't quicken enough on straightening, always held by leaders in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時加速力不足。末段一直未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from the one draw settling just off the pace, obtained cover one back behind leader over 600M out, angled out to challenge upon straightening but faded steadily inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後位置。六百米處落後領放馬一個馬位，有遮擋。入直路時向外移出以展開挑戰，但最後一百米逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Prominent from a poor draw travelling 3-wide early, shared 4th some 3L off the pace from early in back straight, fought on dourly from 2L back into home straight and only to be denied narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第七檔出閘，早段居前列，走第三疊。自對面直路早段起並列第四位，落後領放馬約三個馬位。入直路時持續力拼，落後兩個馬位。僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Always well behind, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿途遙居於後。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded after the start, soon moved forward and vied for the lead, couldn't go on mid-straight and weakened. (Jockey - disadvantaged when pressured in the lead.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後受擠迫，瞬即上前爭奪領先。直路中段無以為繼，轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在領放下受追迫而不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Pressed forward from the widest draw to share the pace racing very wide, obtained 2-wide position in front coming onto first turn 600M out, hung on under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自最外檔出閘後受催策上前，並排領先，走大外疊。六百米處開始轉首個彎位時取得領先，走第二疊。直路上在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced 3 wide towards rear, wider turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Held up last after slowly away, still in last place 400m out, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘緩慢後留居包尾位置。四百米處仍居包尾位置。最後二百米自後列追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Prominent early, unable to sustain and dropped away swiftly in the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;早段居前列。末段無以為繼，迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Badly unbalanced when bumped by rival after the start, ended up racing 3-wide towards the rear, brought widest to the straight then made limited progress to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 起步後被對手碰撞之際嚴重失去平衡，因而居後列，走第三疊。直路前移出最外疊，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, driven along 450m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百五十米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Led early, ceded advantage for one-back 2nd after the first 200M, re-gained lead in home straight 300M out kicking over 2L clear over 150M out, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段領先，過了首二百米後被超越，居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路上三百米處重奪領先位置。一百五十米處加速帶離逾兩個馬位。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a fast pace in middle stages, led the field until headed 250M out and swamped for a placing inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段以快步速領放。帶頭競跑，直至二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米被後上馬匹過頭，失去三甲位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside lead, traveled strongly, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走勢強勁。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑，在領放下受追迫。二百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased the leader, reluctant to improve, gave ground from 250M (See Incident Report, Disappointing Performance, Must BT).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。不願推進。自二百五十米處起墮退。（見競賽事件報告。表現令人失望，必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running from a wide draw and made all, kicking some 3L clear over 100M out and just held off runner-up's late challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即取得領先，沿途領放。一百米處加速帶離約三個馬位。力拒亞軍馬匹的挑戰，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Pressed leader, bumped and lost balance 300m out, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百米處發生碰撞，失去平衡。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Soon led, pressed by rival in middle stages, quickened to a clear lead early straight, kept on well just only to be caught near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段受一駒追迫。直路早段加速帶離對手，保持佳勢，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W2W3W) Tracked leaders, keen middle stages, unable to hold position final bend, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，中段搶口。直路彎未能保持位置。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Fast break, made all, kicked three lengths clear 200m out, won unchallenged and going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，一直領放。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。在未受挑戰下拋離對手取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled nicely, kept on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢良佳。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, lay in in the Straight and difficult to ride out (See Incident Report).
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上內閃，難以被力策。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the stands' side, peaked on run 350M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Made a respiratory noise during the running of the event.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Made a respiratory noise during the running of the event.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，靠近外欄競跑。三百五十米處未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（於陣上發出呼吸聲。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon took up running and led until overhauled inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即取得領先。保持領先，最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Well there from a middle draw, hit the from 700M out kicking over 1L clear briefly onto course proper, unable to sustain effort and folded up quickly inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自中檔出閘後居好位。自七百米處起領先，跑離分支直路時加速，一度領先逾一個馬位。其後無以為繼，最後一百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced down center of the track and stayed close to leaders throughout, failed to pick up speed form 400M, no extra mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;在跑道中央競跑，沿途保持緊隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起未能加速，直路中段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced in touch with leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 300m out, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領先馬匹，走外欄。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mustered no early pace, gradually improved his position further up the field at the centre part of the track middle stages, kept finding plenty to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段缺乏前速。中段逐漸在馬群中推進上前，在跑道中央競跑。保持勁勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield, gave ground quickly entering the Straight (Disappointing Performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置。入直路時迅速墮退。（表現令人失望。必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked leaders, under pressure 350m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。三百五十米處受催策。最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent near the rail early, gradually drifted some 3L off the pace onto course proper, kept on one pace in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段居前列，靠近外欄競跑。跑離分支直路時逐漸墮後，落後領放馬約三個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Broke well from the widest draw and soon taken well back travelling very wide without cover until the 500M, made some impression from last on rail into home straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，瞬即遙居於後。在沒有遮擋下走外疊直至五百米處。入直路時自包尾位置沿欄略為追前，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, dropped to mid-field turning into home straight, briefly hampered 300m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時墮居中間位置。三百米處一度受阻礙。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Broke well from the middle draw, gradually settled 3-wide without cover 2L back in 5th over 600M out, drifted further off the pace rounding home bend and some 4L back into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自中檔出閘迅速。六百米處逐漸居第五位，落後兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時落後領放馬更遠。入直路時落後約四個馬位。持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Raced in last pair after sluggish start and lost ground, last place entering home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢及失地，居最後兩位內。入直路時居包尾位置，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back to last from gate 10, ridden quietly, made up some ground over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十檔出閘後留居包尾位置，未受積極催策。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled wide in rear of midfield, came under pressure rounding home bend, ran on well inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉直路彎時受催策。最後一百五十米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in midfield from moderate start some 3L off the pace, drifted slightly further back onto course proper, renewed effort under pressure inside final 200M, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。跑離分支直路時略為墮後。最後二百米受催策時再度發力，穩步上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, ended up racing at the back of the field, failed to make any real progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居馬群後列。最後四百米無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in mid-field, driven along 600m out, unable to pick up for pressure against rail from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策。自四百米處起沿欄在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From a low draw obtained a midfield position along the inside, couldn't go on passing 300M, weakened to last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自內檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過三百米處時無以為繼。轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, eased when detached 600m out, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速。六百米處被拋離時收慢。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield from draw 12, failed to run on final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自第十二檔出閘，居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後四百米未能追前。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, outpaced middle stages, ran on well in home straight, short of room final 50m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。中段未能跟上步速。直路上保持佳勢。最後五十米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Tracked leader in a fast run race, fought on in the straight to claim 2nd close home but couldn't get near to the winner. (Jockey : lay out under pressure for the majority of home straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，賽事步速甚快。直路上力拼。接近終點時進佔第二位，但未能追近頭馬。（騎師報告，坐騎在直路上大部分途程在催策下外閃。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Settled just behind midfield on rail, carried backward in slackened tempo to last 750m out, baulked for a run and switched 200M out, quickened well to hit the front 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。七百五十米處步速減慢時墮後至包尾位置。二百米處受困，向外移出。加速良佳，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced at rear on the inside, angled out approaching 350M, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走內疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, raced towards rear on the outside, 7-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W2W2W) Began moderately settling at the back and waited with, commenced move on the bend over 400M out, tight between runners upon straightening, ran on well inside final 200M to gain upper hand final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居包尾位置，留力候上。四百米處於直路彎開始上前。入直路時在馬匹之間緊迫競跑。最後二百米走勢良佳，最後數步佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled towards the rear 9-10Ls off the pace in early and middle stages, couldn't go on passing 400M, no extra mid-straight and weakened rapidly. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列，早段及中段落後領放馬九至十個馬位。跑過四百米處時無以為繼。直路中段再無餘力，迅速轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Began slowly losing ground, gradually recovered to just behind midfield on rail, crowded between runners entering home straight, kept on steadily under pressure without quickening inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，失地。逐漸恢復走勢，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。入直路時在馬匹之間受擠迫。最後三百米在催策下保持穩勢，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Sat midfield 2 wide, angled out near 550M, kept on well early in the straight, ran on evenly. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。接近五百五十米處時向外移出。直路早段保持佳勢，末段走勢平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) From wide draw taken back and reserved near last, over 10Ls off leader middle stages, driven 450M and ran to the line well without troubling first few. Pleasing return after long absence.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居接近包尾位置。中段落後領放馬逾十個馬位。四百五十米處受催策。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。久休復出，表現令人滿意。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Gradually settled towards the rear, shifted wide to challenge entering straight, ran on inside final 250M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 逐漸留居後列。入直路時移出外疊以展開挑戰。最後二百五十米上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Held up in 6th some 8L off the pace, lost position to 7th despite closer to pace 1000 metres out, commenced move approaching home turn 500 metres out and widest into straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 留居第六位，落後領放馬約八個馬位。一千米處追近領放馬，但失位，居第七位。五百米處趨近直路彎時開始發力，入直路時走最外疊。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Obtained a position behind midfield, came under pressure middle stages, couldn't finish it off turning home. (Jockey : failed to handle the Yielding track conditions)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。中段受催策。轉入直路時衝刺乏力。（騎師表示，坐騎未能應付黏地的場地狀況。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Chased the pace along the inside, loomed behind leaders early straight, improved into a narrow run mid-straight but was badly checked nearing 100M and lost his chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬，走內疊。直路初居領先馬匹之後位置。直路中段推進至窄位，但接近一百米處時大力勒避，失去爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, sat in 3rd 4-5Ls off leader middle stages, tried hard on straightening but couldn't muster the pace to challenge first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙。中段居第三位，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。入直路時力拼，但未能加速以挑戰頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W1W2W) Settled just off the pace in 3rd on rail, some 3L off the pace in back straight and further off speed rounding home bend, commenced move into straight but unable to quicken under pressure, dropped away quickly inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W1W2W) 居領放馬稍後的第三位，走內欄。對面直路上落後領放馬約三個馬位。轉直路彎時落後領放馬更遠。入直路時開始上前，但在催策下未能增速。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen early, checked 200m out, lost all chance and allowed to coast home.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。二百米處勒避。其後再無爭逐機會，獲許順其自然地競跑至終點。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) From draw 13 slotted into a 3-wide spot in mid-division, kept on steadily to be challenging for the lead mid-straight, peaked on its run 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊。保持穩勢，直路中段爭奪領先。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled within 3L of pace mainly in 4th, commenced move on top of home bend 650M out, gained upper hand under pressure 200M out, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 大多居第四位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。直路彎早段六百五十米處開始上前。二百米處在催策下取得領先，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Soon recovered to 6th from moderate start travelling keenly at times in back straight, in similar position turning in for home, tight between runners early on, made up some late ground inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 起步普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居第六位，對面直路上不時搶口。轉入直路時居相若位置。直路早段在馬匹之間緊迫競跑，最後一百米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Began awkwardly from wide draw then dropped back to race in last spot over 10Ls off leader, still in clear last top of the straight, ran past well beaten horses only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自最外檔出閘笨拙，其後墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾十個馬位。直路初仍遙居包尾位置。末段僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back to near last on jumping from wide draw, raced keenly in middle stages, 5-6Ls off leader home turn but failed to quicken. Never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居接近包尾位置。中段搶口。直路彎落後領放馬五至六個馬位，但未能加速。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along final bend to chase leaders, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎受推策以追趕領先馬匹。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Chased the pace on the inside, pushed along 500M to keep up the chase on leader, couldn't get any closer final 150M, lost 3rd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬，走內疊。五百米處受推策以持續追趕領放馬。最後一百五十米未能再追近，接近終點時失去第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, angled out 500M, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield, held up rounding the Turn, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時受困。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W3W5W) Gradually settled behind midfield 2-wide from draw 12, keen when switched 3-wide no cover 1100M, made swift headway to 3L 6th slackened tempo in back straight, swung wide for home, ran on steadily to go 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W3W5W) 自第十二檔出閘，逐漸居中間之後位置，走第二疊。千一米處移至第三疊時搶口，沒有遮擋。對面直路上步速減慢時快速上前，居第六位，落後三個馬位。入直路時移出外疊。末段穩步上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Away awkwardly, reserved behind midfield 7-8Ls off leader, failed to pick up pace in the straight, eased when no chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，落後領放馬七至八個馬位。直路上未能加速。失去爭勝機會時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢良佳。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, traveled smoothly, made steady progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。走勢暢順。末段在催策下穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Gradually settled in midfield 2-wide, became 7th early in back straight when tempo slackened, commenced move home bend swinging wide into straight, quickened well to hit the front over 150M out only to be caught at the 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 逐漸居中間位置，走第二疊。對面直路早段步速減慢時居第七位。直路彎開始上前，入直路時移出外疊。加速良佳，一百五十米處取得領先，僅在五十米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W2W3W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out and moved a bit closer after passing 600M, 3Ls back turning in, not much room early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W2W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出，略為追近。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初空位不足，二百米處望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W4W) Made contact shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off very strongly to score, won by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺凌厲，以一馬頸位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Went forward from a wide draw and obtained a position outside the leader, gained narrow lead 350M, kept battling but was outpaced by rivals final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後上前，居領放馬外側。三百五十米處以短距離領先。持續力拼，但最後一百五十米被對手拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Settled back in the field in a race being run outside of standard time, failed to run on in the home straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居後列，賽事步速較標準時間為慢。直路上未能追前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W2W2W) Not hurried early stages, dropped back to a rearward spot 5-6Ls off the pace, ran on well final 300M to be nearest at the line. Just missed out on 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W2W2W) 早段未受催策，墮退至後列，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。最後三百米走勢良佳，過終點時最為接近，僅失季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, strong run final 200m to lead 50m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米衝刺強勁，五十米處取得領先，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) From a wide draw given a conservative ride at the rear early stages, held up on the home turn behind a weakening rival before running on well to take 3rd close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，早段居後列，留後競跑。直路彎時在轉弱的對手之後受困。其後以佳勢上前，接近終點時進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid-division, forward move wide on bend, upsides leaders and in contention 200m out, unable to sustain effort.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前，走外疊。二百米處上前追逼領先馬匹，具爭逐機會，但末段無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderate start, towards rear in 7th early stages, improved to 5th along rail about 3L off the pace approaching home bend, saved ground turning in for home, faded out of contention inside final 150M .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，早段居後列第七位。趨近直路彎時推進至第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。最後一百五十米力竭，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) From draw 1 moved up to race in 5th, always close enough to leaders, shifted out from fence passing 500M, ran on well final 300M to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自第一檔出閘後上前，居第五位，沿途保持落後領先馬匹不遠。跑過五百米處時移離內欄。最後三百米走勢良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, ran on well final 200m, tight for room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居包尾位置。最後二百米以佳勢上前。接近終點時受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W2W3W) From draw 1 obtained running in midfield, switched to 2-wide 1100M, driven 400M out, ran on strongly down outside to get up close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W2W3W) 自第一檔出閘後居中間位置。千一米處移至第二疊。四百米處受催策。末段沿外疊以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, followed winner through 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。二百米處跟隨頭馬上前。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled just off the pace in 3rd on rail, became 4th in a similar position 700M out, commenced move on home bend 500M out stalking the leader into straight, gained upper hand under pressure 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領放馬稍後的第三位，走內欄。七百米處居相若的第四位。五百米處直路彎開始上前，入直路時跟隨領放馬。一百米處在催策下佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W3W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, switched in for clear run 150m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。一百五十米處向內移入以望空。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W1W3W) Sat rear, traveled fairly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W1W3W) 居包尾位置。走勢一般。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Settled in last few in 6th on rail some 6L off the pace, further away in increased pace around home bend, obtained clear run inside 300M and quickened well, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 居最後數位之內的第六位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎賽事步速加快時落後更遠。最後三百米望空，以佳勢加速。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Reserved in midfield 5Ls off the steady pace, quickened up well in the straight to be challenging for the lead, in front near 150M but couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 留居中間位置，落後步速平穩的領放馬五個馬位。直路上以佳勢加速，爭奪領先。接近一百五十米處時取得領先，但末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Travelled in midfield 6-7Ls off the pace middle stages, in 4th spot throughout, couldn't improve position final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。中段落後領放馬六至七個馬位。沿途居第四位。最後四百米未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in second half of the field 4-5Ls off the pace, responded fairly on straightening and was unable to make ground on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。入直路時對催策反應一般，未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, taken wide 300m out, quickened well to pass rivals and lead 150m out, kept going to line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。三百米處移出外疊。加速良佳，超越對手，一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, mid division, under pressure 400m out, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與一駒互相碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處受催策。以佳勢上前，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Moderately away, happy to let the speed go in midfield one off, 5Ls or so off the leader turning for home, let down sharply centre of track but just unable to pip the winner bob of the heads.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 出閘普通，放棄爭奪領先，居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時落後領放馬約五個馬位。末段在跑道中央以勁勢上前，但在叮噹馬頭下僅敗於頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stayed close enough behind leaders, moved up to challenge 400M, badly crowded between rivals 150M before fading away over concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處上前展開挑戰。一百五十米處在馬匹之間嚴重受擠迫。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden along 500m out, headed 300m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。五百米處受催策。三百米處被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Away on terms, moved up to be tracking the pace on outside, kept up the chase on leader turning home, fought hard but was held by first two late stage. Hung on for 3rd just.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走外疊。入直路時持續追趕領放馬，但末段未能追上頭兩名馬匹。僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Ended up racing in midfield along the 3-path, soon left behind on straightening and finished tailed out. (Jockey - failed to show sufficient pace to go forward as instructed due to the ""Soft"" track conditions.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時瞬即被拋離，大敗而回。（騎師表示，由於「軟地」的場地狀況，坐騎未能展現足夠前速以如指示般上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Sent forward from wide draw and raced upsides leader, weakened final 200m.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，追逼領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Slightly slow out, well there early stages before drifting back to 5th passing the 1000M, became 6th some 3L back rounding home bend, given reminders 600M out but had nothing to give in straight and checked 180M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘稍慢，早段居好位。跑過一千米處時墮居第五位。轉直路彎時居第六位，落後約三個馬位。六百米處受鞭策。直路上再無餘力。一百八十米處勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, one pace to the finish (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sent to the lead under 7lb claimer, raced keenly and did not settle which resulted in the early and middle stages being run inside of standard time, headed nearing 200M then weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 由獲讓七磅的見習騎師策騎，受催策上前領放。搶口及未能穩定走勢，導致賽事早段及中段的步速較標準時間為快。接近二百米處時被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Caught wide early stages, retrained to a rear spot settled further back than intended, had some work to do 400M but made only limited progress to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，其後受約束以居較賽前部署為後的後列位置。四百米處落後頗遠，但末段僅能略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden along final bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 800m out, sustained headway to join leader 200m out, stuck to task.
