runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。八百米處開始上前，走外疊。持續追前，二百米處追上領放馬。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked pace, trapped behind horses for much of home straight, clear over 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上大部分途程在馬群之後受困。一百米處望空，但未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) Sat midfield early, raced wide in the early stages and went forward to chase the leader, weakened from 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 早段居中間位置，走外疊，其後上前追趕領放馬。自二百米處起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W2W2W) Chased the leader, traveled strongly, switched out rounding the Turn, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬。走勢強勁。轉直路彎時向外移出，以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled 2-wide ahead of midfield, in touch making the turn for home, stayed on mildly towards the finish and just lost out in a photo finish for 3rd and 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時居啣接位置。保持一般走勢至終點，在電眼判決下僅失季軍及第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Away well, positioned 2 wide, 2-1/2L back, same position on turn, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 50M, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後兩個半馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近五十米處時取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly to 350m out, strong run to lead 200m out, won comfortably and going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百五十米處前走勢暢順。衝刺強勁，二百米處取得領先。帶離對手，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Chased leaders on the inside, held up making the home turn and early straight, obtained clear running passing 250M and closed off well enough to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 追趕領先馬匹，走內疊。轉直路彎時及直路初受困。跑過二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, raised tempo 800m out, kicked 400m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 前速甚快，取得領先。八百米處加快步速。四百米處加速。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, wider turning in, steadied approaching 350M, made good progress thereafter to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走更外疊。趨近三百五十米處時收慢。其後追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 3 wide at rear, angled out after passing 500M, made contact near 450M, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居後列，走第三疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。接近四百五十米處時發生觸碰。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W3W5W) Switched off to the rear early stages, raced as the back marker in a fast run race before commencing a wide move from 700M, came with a sustained bid to lead nearing 200M, kept on well to win comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W3W5W) 早段留居後列。在快步速下居包尾位置。自七百米處開始在外疊推進。持續上前，接近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，輕鬆掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Tightened at start settling in rear on rail and waited with, obtained a clear run near the centre of the track over 150M out, quickened well to snatch victory close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時受緊迫，居後列，走內欄，留力候上。一百五十米處在靠近跑道中央位置望空。末段加速良佳，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W3W) Moderately away, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, a bit closer turning in, peaked on run 200M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時略為追近。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W1W) Held up last, briefly hampered against rail 1400m out, some headway middle stages, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。千四米處沿欄競跑時一度受阻礙。中段略為追前。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W1W) Waited with towards rear, challenged up rail from 200m out, ran on well to make up several places.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。末段走勢良佳，追前數位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (5W4W3W4W) Mid division, improved to track pace out wide without cover 1300m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(5W4W3W4W) 中間位置。推進上前，千三米處跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上迅速墮退。
